create_dictionary: create a Dictionary instance with id2word, word2id mappings and a language string
test_dictionary_len: test the Dictionary __len__ method to return the number of words in the vocabulary
build_dictionary_lookup: build a Dictionary lookup to find the index of a word using the index method
refactor_dictionary_prune: refactor the Dictionary prune method to limit vocabulary size to a maximum word count
review_dictionary_equality: review the Dictionary __eq__ method to compare two dictionaries for equality
